name.description:
The test case name is taken from the appended heading texts. If there is no preceding heading, "test" is used.
All names are unique within the test suite so they can be used for result reporting.

lineNumber.description: If loaded from a Markdown file, the line number of the fenced code block.

headings.description:
The text of the headings active at the point of this test code block. The first heading is the outermost one
and the latter ones (if any) are innermost (deeper nesting level) headings.

comment.description:
The text of Markdown (other than headings) associated with this test case. Note that this may contain
multiple lines.

source.description: The original test code from the fenced code block.

script.description: The script parsed from the source.

constraints.description:
The block that defines the domain of the variables. It is a map of variable name to
{@link TestSuite.PolyPropertyVar}

examples.description:
The block of combination of variables that are to be run are stored in examples. It is an array of maps of variable
name to value. The map should contain all the property variables.

skips.description:
The block of combination of variables that are to be skipped are stored in skip. It is an array of maps of
variable name to value.

title:
In property based poly testing, each test is composed of up to four blocks:
 - #constraints defines the domain of variables by specifying their type and applying filters to them
 - #examples declares discrete combinations of variables that are supposed to run along with other generated ones.
 - #skips declares discrete combinations of variables that are to be skipped.
 - #property the test block; this asserts properties which must hold true for all variables in the specified domain
The `constraints` block is not optional and applies to all the `property` blocks. One file should have a single constraints block.
The `examples` and `skips` blocks are optional and apply to the immediately following `property` block.
For a `PolyProperty` the `property` block is necessary.

The inherited #script is the `property` block, and `constraints`, `examples`, `skips` and `pbtFilters` are additional fields.
name: TestSuite.PolyProperty
